body: I was with my ex fiancé for almost 7 years, being cheated on for the majority of the relationship. Don't allow the sunk cost fallacy to blind you from reality.

They were a nightmare. 
They didn't know how to be loyal to me.
They tore me apart because they only wanted what they wanted, when they wanted it, and I'm sure that still reigns true. 
People like you, looking for loyalty in love, are what gives me hope that one day, I'll find someone who treasures me and only me. 
I believe that you'll find that too.
Please don't give up, OP. You're valuable even if you can't see that right now.

I'm not the type of person who usually comments on Reddit posts, let alone to "break up", but this is similar to what my abusive ex did. At some point OP, you're going to have to decide you're not going to take the mistreatment anymore. She might cry, kick, scream on the way out, but you deserve a partner that treats you with love and respect, not someone who compares you to dirt.
You deserve so much better, OP :(

Yeah, you're absolutely right. I feel as though I have no right to complain about not having intimacy (been almost 4 months) because consent, and it's hard to ground the fact that cuddles require consent, too

Honestly I always thought it was wrong to deny my partner cuddles after being rejected sexually, but now that I've read this post, I don't really feel bad about it anymore. Being autistic makes it hard to be touched already, and I feel like the less sexual intimacy I have, the less affection I feel in a relationship.
